# Linear Ticket Writer

This is a **shared utility skill**, primarily loaded by other skills and prompts to ensure every Linear ticket follows a consistent format. It can also be invoked directly to create a single well-structured Linear ticket.

---

## Pre-Creation Steps

Before creating any tickets, always perform these steps in order:

1. **Discover the team** — call `mcp_linear_list_teams` and select the correct team. Store its ID.
2. **Discover labels** — call `mcp_linear_list_issue_labels` and use existing IDs. Never invent label IDs.
3. **Create feature label (if needed)** — if a caller-specific label (e.g. `{featureLabel}-performance`) does not exist, create it via `mcp_linear_create_issue_label` with an appropriate color:
   - `#DC2626` — Critical / Urgent
   - `#F97316` — High
   - `#EAB308` — Medium
   - `#6B7280` — Low / Info

---

## Title Format

```
[{FeatureName}] {Concise imperative title}
```

- Max **80 characters**.
- `{FeatureName}` is PascalCase (e.g. `TopUsers`, `Alerts`, `Payments`).
- The imperative title describes **what** needs to happen (e.g. `Fix N+1 query in getTopUsers action`).
- Optionally append ` — {file basename}` when the issue is file-specific.

**Examples:**

- `[TopUsers] Fix N+1 query in getTopUsers action — top-users.ts`
- `[Alerts] Add pagination to alerts list`
- `[Payments] Missing session check before charge`

---

## Description Format

Use this exact markdown structure for every issue body. Include every section; write "N/A" for any field that does not apply.

```markdown
## What

<!-- One sentence: what needs to be built or fixed -->

## Problem

<!-- Detailed explanation of what is wrong and why it matters -->

## Location

- **File:** `{relative path}`
- **Line(s):** {line numbers or "N/A"}

## Impact

<!-- Severity + one sentence on user-visible or system impact -->
<!-- e.g. "High — causes full table re-render on every keystroke" -->

## Suggested Fix

<!-- Concrete recommendation — include a code snippet if helpful -->

## Effort Estimate

<!-- Low / Medium / High -->

## Layer

<!-- Architecture | Security | Performance | Error Handling | Data Integrity | Product -->

## Source

<!-- Which skill/prompt generated this ticket -->
<!-- e.g. "Generated by performance-auditor on 2026-05-28" -->
```

---

## Priority Mapping

| Severity            | Linear Priority Value | Linear Priority Name |
| ------------------- | --------------------- | -------------------- |
| Critical            | 1                     | Urgent               |
| High                | 1                     | Urgent               |
| Medium              | 2                     | High                 |
| Low                 | 3                     | Medium               |
| Info / Nice-to-Have | 4                     | Low                  |

---

## Label Strategy

Apply labels from this table. Use the closest existing label — do **not** fail if an exact match is missing.

| Finding Type                | Recommended Labels                     |
| --------------------------- | -------------------------------------- |
| Critical / High security    | `bug`, `security`, `{source-label}`    |
| Critical / High performance | `bug`, `performance`, `{source-label}` |
| Medium technical issue      | `tech-debt`, `{source-label}`          |
| Must-Have product gap       | `must-have`, `{source-label}`          |
| Should-Have improvement     | `enhancement`, `{source-label}`        |
| Nice-to-Have                | `nice-to-have`, `{source-label}`       |

`{source-label}` is the caller-specific label (e.g. `top-users-performance`, `feature-analysis`).

---

## Batching Rules

- Create tickets **one at a time** (Linear API is not bulk).
- After each creation, print the ticket ID and URL so the user can track progress.
- If any ticket fails to create, log the title and error — do **not** abort the remaining tickets.

---

## Post-Creation Summary

After all tickets are created, output this block (callers may append extra lines):

```
## Linear Issues Created

### Critical / High (Urgent)
- [XX-123] [Feature] Title — https://linear.app/...

### Medium (High)
- ...

### Low / Nice-to-Have
- ...

Total: X issues created.
```
